sources.title: Punctuation Restoration in Python — Add Punctuation to Text / ASR ...
sources.snippet: Punctuation restoration adds the commas, periods, and question marks back so the transcript is readable. FunASR's ct-punc is an open-source punctuation-restoration model that works for both Chinese and English, adding punctuation to any text in three lines of Python.
